source: The Estonian wordings of the Accounting Act annexes and of form KMD are published in official English translations by Riigi Teataja and by the Estonian Tax and Customs Board; those wordings are used here verbatim, and the rest is translated.

legal_mentions.intracom_goods: Intra-Community supply of goods, taxable at 0% — VAT Act § 15 (3) 2); Council Directive 2006/112/EC, Article 138.
legal_mentions.intracom_services: Reverse charge — value added tax is payable by the recipient of the service. Council Directive 2006/112/EC, Articles 44 and 196.
legal_mentions.exempt: Supply exempt from tax — VAT Act § 16.
legal_mentions.small_business: No value added tax is added — the undertaking is not registered as a taxable person (VAT Act § 19).
legal_mentions.late_payment: Where payment is late, the seller may claim penalty interest at the rate laid down in § 113 (1) of the Law of Obligations Act and compensation for collection costs of 40 euros.
